entries.claim: user_stiffness_local_matrix adds one relative spring per local DOF (UX axial, UY/UZ lateral, RX torsional, RY/RZ angular) via add_relative_dof_stiffness; there is no UY-RZ or UZ-RY coupling and no length term, so a lateral spring acting over a finite span is not balanced by end moments.
UserStiffnessElement: new() requires all four stiffnesses finite and positive (647-652) and a non-zero length (local_x_axis normalize, 665-671); local_stiffness() and global_stiffness() are public.

assemble_global_stiffness_with_user_elements assembles the user elements into the dense global matrix (also sparse: FK/src/structural/sparse.rs:506-600; nonlinear: NI/src/structural_adapter.rs, 45 sites).

build_expansion_joint_user_stiffness_elements builds one element between the joint pipe's two nodes; the joint's own pipe stays a full frame element in parallel (7401-7408 push every non-curved pipe). JR/CONTRACT.md:7 records both defects: finite-span lateral springs resist common rigid rotation, and the ordinary pipe is added in parallel.

Exact Fraction transcription of F1 (demo values, L = 2.2 m): an infinitesimal rigid rotation 1e-3 rad about local z gives end forces -1980/+1980 N (should be 0); a relative lateral displacement delta = 3.325438e-4 m gives Fy = -/+299.2894 N, zero end moments, net moment 658.4367607916 N*m. Control: lateral = 0 gives exactly 0.

Independent 2026-09-08 literal-adapter reconstruction of the demo with C-150: net force residual 1.46e-10 N, global moment residual 658.4367607905363 N*m about Y; C-150's own end actions carry a net 658.4367607916422 N*m.
Literal mapping places [3.2e6, 0.9e6, 0.9e6, 0.62e6, 0.48e6, 0.48e6] between the ends of unchanged P-130, in parallel; the uncancelled couple 658.4368 N*m prevents use as a whole-frame oracle.

Committed hand-statics citation: 900000 * 3.3254e-4 m * 2.2 m = 658.44 N*m (with delta rounded to 3.3254e-4 the product is 658.43; 658.44 follows from delta = 3.325438e-4, F5/F6). Same figure in T/../DEFAULT_ROUTE_DESIGN/IMPLEMENTATION/S6_RECORD.md:23.

refuse_unqualified_joint_elements: blocking JOINT_ELEMENT_EQUILIBRIUM_UNQUALIFIED for an expansion joint with mechanics_geometry_and_user_flexibility, nonzero lateral and distinct end positions. Lines 111-115: the only bypass is #[cfg(test)] historical_pressure_reference::active().
The refusal runs in run_linear_static_preview_observed before build_model_for_members and returns blocked_envelope; every case loop (2575, 2667) is after it.

Every public solve entry (run_linear_static_preview[_with_mode], _value_with_mode, _value_with_retained_direct/_headless) reaches run_linear_static_preview_observed: the ordinary route via ordinary_dispatch, the retained route via permitted_dispatch -> permitted_run (3002); PP/src/retained_product.rs:4087-4091 (prepare_observed) also runs the observed route.

Builder success implies the refusal fires: new() needs lateral > 0 and distinct nodes, which is exactly the refusal's condition. Lateral = 0 fails new() (blocking EXPANSION_JOINT_MACRO_ELEMENT_INPUT_INVALID); missing stiffness is a warning and the builder skips the joint (no element).

The exact pressure contract (0.3.0 exact, 0.4.0) refuses every component with EXACT_PRESSURE_COMPOSITION_UNSUPPORTED before the joint refusal is reached. The joint refusal is live only for 0.1.0, 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 + 1.0.0/legacy_pressure_v1 documents (pressure_runtime.rs:111-145).
mod historical_pressure_reference is #[cfg(test)]: it exists only in product_physics' own unit-test build; integration tests and downstream crates cannot enter it.

Defence in depth behind the refusal: K-D5 demotes a nonzero-lateral joint (user_stiffness_lateral_nonzero); W4 treats it as a tie; W2 admission names user_stiffness_element as not admitted ('every realizable one is refused by M07 containment or input validation'); source recovery and the retained capture reject the user-matrix family.
Desktop native and headless runner solve only through PP's public entries (G3), so they inherit the refusal.

The two WASM engines (operation_applier, self_weight_wasm) link PP for types and self-weight planning only; neither builds or assembles the element. The authoring UI and the WASM operation engine can author an expansion joint with positive lateral stiffness; its solve is then refused (G1) or, under the exact contract, refused as a component (G5).

Not the element code but its stored output: the browser app's reference-only inspection shows bundled precision-1 results of the full demo (MECHANICS_SOLVED, 7 C-150 rows, macro count 4) produced with the flawed element (and legacy pressure); also read by many app and e2e tests. Shared with I110's pressure inventory.

entries.claim: C-150 changes the demo's friction-normal path materially (independent physical frame without C-150: S-130 normal 52.37 N; literal C-150: 40.91 N, on the same seed). The O1/O2 constants were calibrated on the full demo (V4: 'six-decimal mu=0 public normal observations'), so they are values of a model containing the flawed element.

Within O1/O2 the law checks (friction = 0.01 N, friction*slip < 0, the stop-release branch) hold for any stiffness; joint-free derived-normal friction tests exist (NL-FRIC-SLIDE-110, NL-MIX-FRIC-110, NL-FRIC-110, NL-FRIC-DERIVED-110). The three-way reversal with stop release is exercised only by O1.

T4's repair is a different element (energy-derived six-coordinate B, Ke = B^T K B, offsets, Q, 21-entry H, replaced span), not a patch of F1. Four legacy scalar rates cannot be mapped automatically (11); fresh finite-span legacy joints block with LEGACY_FINITE_CONNECTOR_REAUTHOR_REQUIRED (52); J1-J4 synthetic references (120-140); J-A preserves UserStiffnessElement 'for historical witnesses only' (144).

The connector oracle set (rigid_modes, six_components, coupled_H_case, offset, reversal, PSD_cases, topologies, raw_difference_mutation) lives in execution records; T4's negative control for today's element is the analytic raw_difference_mutation, not the product code.
